paragraphs: Issi bar Hini, [Shabbat 147a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.147a.7); R' Levi bar Hini (Hina), [Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 4:3:3 (Hyman cites 4:2)](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Terumot.4.3.3).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Shabbat reads Assi bar Hini. [Heilprin’s name index](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1030&lang=en) gives Issi or Assi and also lists Levi bar Hini.
The linked Terumot has Rabbi Levi bar China (חינא) at 4:3:3. Hyman gives Hini or Hina and cites 4:2.
